This Ability applies on-hit and spell effects. Max @MaxExecuteVsMonsters@ bonus damage vs. jungle monsters.

KaylePassive.name: Divine Ascent
KaylePassive.tooltip:
Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points.

  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank0@ - Zealous: Attacks grant @EnrageTotalASPerStack@% Attack Speed for @EnrageDuration@ seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining @MSTowardsEnemy*100@% Move Speed.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank1@ - Arisen: Attack range is increased to @UpgradedAttackRange@.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank2@ - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal @PassiveWaveDamage@ magic damage.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank3@ - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to @FinalAttackRange@.

KayleW.name: Celestial Blessing
KayleW.tooltip:
Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring @TotalHeal@ Health and granting @TotalHaste@ Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds.
If cast without a target, this Ability will heal the most wounded ally in range.
